name: ob1-auth-poc
comment: The authorization-server POC's container side (SMD-2285): the stand-ins, the CIMD host, the bait and the runner-up. The winner is the deploy's own image (deploy/auth/package.json pins oidc-provider). Better Auth and its two plugins (the runner-up) are pinned exactly, for its 2026 advisory record. The MCP packages match server-portable's (SMD-2278).
